title: Fullstack React .NET Cloud & Container Setup
excerpt: A full setup solution for a React fronend and .NET backend using containerization, database, Git, GitHub actions and Terraform

body.raw:
# Fullstack React .NET Cloud & Container Setup

Simple Guide to build a fullstack application using .NET as backend and react as frontend. Published in Azure using GitHub, Terraform and GitHub actions.


# Architecture Overview

<BlogImage
  src="/Reactdotnet.drawio.png"
  alt="Reactdotnet"
  size="large"
/>


The application consists of:

- Frontend: React (TypeScript) - Vite
- Backend: ASP.NET Core API
- Database: Azure SQL
- Deployment: Azure + GitHub Actions

## Database Structure

<BlogImage
  src="/database.png"
  alt="database"
  size="large"
/>

## ✅ Prerequisites

- Visual Studio Professsional 2026
- Node.js
- .NET SDK
- SQL Server Management Studio (SMSS)
- Docker / Podman
- Azure CLI

## Install .NET backend extentions


### Install Entity Framework

`dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore` OR use nuget package manager

`dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SQLServer` OR use nuget package manager

`dotnet add package Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools` OR use nuget package manager

### OpenAPI

`dotnet add package Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenAPI` OR use nuget package manager

### Scalar for OpenAPI

`dotnet add package Scalar.AspNetCore` OR use nuget package manager
